messages:
Maria G: Heads-up — BlueHarbor (tenant th-bh-003) says their API key never showed up after SSO onboarding. They finished the OIDC flow, console reports 'Onboarding complete', but Projects -> Keys is empty. Customer blocked, can't call /v1/generate (401).

Maria G: Repro steps from customer:
1) Sign up via Azure AD SSO
2) Redirected back to https://console.redwood.com/onboard?claim=abc123
3) Click 'Finish onboarding'
4) No API key visible in UI. Requests return 401 with error `missing_api_key`.

Maria G: User contact is alex@blueharbor.com. Project they expect: blueharbor-prod. Can someone triage? :thinking:

Devon K: Looking. Can you paste the claim id and the tenant id? Also any screenshot of the console banner?

Maria G: Claim id is `abc123`. Screenshot: they have the final "Onboarding complete" modal and a link to the project page but keys list empty.

Onboard Bot: Received events for claim `abc123`:
```json
{
  "event": "tenant.claim.created",
  "claim_id": "abc123",
  "tenant_id": "th-bh-003",
  "redirect_uri": "https://console.redwood.com/onboard",
  "timestamp": "2103456778"
}
```

Onboard Bot: Also emitted an api key creation event shortly after:
```json
{
  "event": "api_key.generated",
  "key_id": "sk_live_XXXX",
  "bound_project": "sandbox-autogen-7",
  "claim_ref": "abc123",
  "timestamp": "2103456780"
}
```

Devon K: Hmm — key was created but bound to `sandbox-autogen-7` instead of `blueharbor-prod`. That explains 401 for the customer's project. Looks like claim_ref exists but the project mapping lookup returned the fallback sandbox project.

Jordan T: This smells like the old race we saw in 2025 where the claim -> project mapping isn't populated before the key generator job runs. Often caused by slight redirect_uri mismatch (trailing slash or query param) so the broker falls back. Any chance the customer's app uses a redirect like `https://console.redwood.com/onboard/` vs `.../onboard`?

Maria G: Customer confirms their IdP app uses `https://console.redwood.com/onboard/` (with trailing slash). Their SSO config was provided by us as `https://console.redwood.com/onboard` (no trailing slash).

Devon K: That matches. Auth service accepted it (IdP allowed both), we created claim `abc123` but when the async claim-enricher ran, the exact redirect_uri key didn't match, so enrich failed and keygen used default.

Eng Infra: I pulled the onboarding-service logs for claim `abc123`. Snippet:
```
[2103456778] claim-service: created claim abc123 for tenant th-bh-003 redirect_uri=https://console.redwood.com/onboard/
[2103456779] claim-enricher: lookup project for claim abc123 -> NOT FOUND
[2103456780] keygen-worker: generated key sk_live_XXXX -> bound_project=sandbox-autogen-7 claim_ref=abc123
```

Eng Infra: Root cause is twofold: (1) claim enrichment expects normalized redirect_uri without trailing slash, (2) keygen-worker doesn't wait for enrichment; it just processes claim events as they arrive. We'll open a patch to normalize URIs and make keygen idempotently rebind if enrichment arrives within N seconds.

Devon K: Short-term workaround: I can create a project-scoped key and DM Alex so they can continue.

Devon K: Creating manual key now via admin CLI: `rwctl api-key create --project blueharbor-prod --label onboard-manual --scopes inference:generate,embedding:read` and will set expiration 7d.

Devon K: Key created (sk_test_tmp_YYYY). DMing to Maria to pass to Alex. :white_check_mark:

Maria G: Sent to customer. They confirmed they can call /v1/generate now. Thanks.

Eng Infra: We'll push a hotfix: normalize redirect URIs on claim creation and make keygen re-check enrichment for 30s. ETA for PR: today, canary deploy tomorrow, full rollout after automated checks. I'll link PR here when ready and cc @product-security for risk review.

Jordan T: Also suggest adding an audit trace in the console UI showing which project a key is bound to at onboarding time — will help support triage. Filing a small product ticket.

Maria G: Filing support ticket for BlueHarbor with notes + manual key info and escalation to eng infra. Ticket #SUP-7452.

Devon K: @Eng Infra once you have the PR/sha, please post so I can close the customer loop.

Eng Infra: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/onboard-service/pull/2374 (normalize redirect + keygen re-check). Patch adds a defensive check: if enrichment arrives within 30s, keybind is updated and an admin audit log entry created.

Maria G: Great. I'll keep the ticket open until the patch is live in canary. Thanks everyone. :pray:
